news.title: McBride named director of Enterprise Risk Management at UW–Madison
news.summary_en: As the program’s inaugural director, McBride will coordinate an enterprise-wide approach to managing the full range of risks that could affect UW, from both inside and outside the organization.

news.title: PharmTox program delivers exceptional outcomes
news.summary_en: Whether they pursue pharmacy, medicine, research or industry, UW–Madison PharmTox graduates are prepared to succeed.

news.title: We are the champions
news.summary_en: From the soccer pitch to the ice rink, revisit some of the most memorable national title runs in Badger sports history.

news.title: UW faculty receive 2026-27 WARF, Kellett and Romnes honors
news.summary_en: Forty-two faculty members spanning the arts and humanities, physical sciences, social sciences and biological sciences have been awarded fellowships from the Office of the Vice Chancellor for Research.

news.title: August 10 campus cooling update: All buildings operational
news.summary_en: All buildings have reopened and have returned to normal operations. All employees located in these buildings should return to their standard onsite workplace arrangements

news.title: New UW–Madison center accelerates discovery where materials meet their limits
news.summary_en: A team of UW engineers has received nearly $25 million from the NSF to accelerate the discovery and development of “super” materials that can withstand extreme conditions.
